title: Morgan Wallen Dangerous Album Cover
coreRelationships: Musician as central figure, grounded by the stool and guitar.
Distressed brick wall and grimy window establish a raw, industrial setting.
Lighting from the window creates strong contrast and highlights the musician.
Typography elements are integrated into the wall texture, appearing hand-drawn or stenciled.
reuseFormula: Recreate a moody, industrial-inspired setting with a seated musician and an acoustic guitar. Integrate custom-lettered album title and artist name, along with clean, condensed tracklists, directly onto a distressed brick wall background, ensuring all text appears to be part of the environment.
